Found by scripts/ads-ratio-census.mjs (lib/server/secAdsRatio.ts). A symbol not listed keeps the depositary-share refusal; a ratio is never inferred or defaulted to 1. Read by lib/server/secAdsMap.ts. kind 'ordinary' = the 20-F cover's Section 12(b) row lists ordinary/common shares under the ticker and the filing has no ADS (ratio 1, cited). BBD and CIG are left out: their ADSs are of preferred shares and the quoted line is the common-share ADS.
